selected_script.angle: Upgrading cluttered utility closet doors with tool-free adhesive wall organization
selected_script.hook: I used to hate opening my utility closet because everything would just tumble out.

scene_01.voiceover: I used to hate opening my utility closet because everything would just tumble out. But this wall-mounted organizer completely transformed this messy corner.
scene_01.visual_description: A creator opens a utility closet door, showing brooms and mops falling over. She then holds up the gray 5-clip 5-hook holder and easily sticks it to the inside of the door.

scene_02.voiceover: It has five non-slip silicone rollers that automatically adjust to grip different handle sizes, plus five hooks for smaller items like cloths.
scene_02.visual_description: Close-up of pushing a mop handle into one of the white roller slots. Then hanging a spray bottle and microfiber towel on the lower J-hooks.

scene_03.voiceover: Everything is finally off the floor and perfectly organized. You need this to reclaim your storage space today!
scene_03.visual_description: The creator steps back, revealing all 5 slots and 5 hooks holding cleaning tools neatly on the door. The floor is clean and empty.

scene_04.visual_description: Detailed B-roll showing the automatic grip mechanism and the self-adhesive backing sticking flat against the surface.
